all four capabilities have a design note under molds/mold_v2/

deployed: governor and budget limits enforceable per org in production
released: governance controls documented for a customer security review

products.name: MCP Product Shell
products.tagline: An agent-run shell with an MCP front door: workspaces, sandboxed harness runs, a metered inference gateway, vaults and record areas, with each product's surface in a pack
products.target_model: any model the inference gateway serves to sandboxed harness runs, metered per run

stamped: molds/mold_v0/codebase pinned at a recorded commit (mold_v0-022, 027), then in-tree with its fork point recorded (mold_v0-040)
MOLD.md and SCOPE.md describe the agent-run shell, its pack and record-area contract and where each capability lives; one app's four state files validate (factory.py validate)
the pack seam works: zero packs is a neutral shell that passes smoke and tenant-sql, and packs ["octillion"] reproduces the old pin with an empty surface diff (mold_v0-038, 039)
lanes_passing: the five mold_v0 lanes, each with a harness (mold_v0-021: load, accessibility and responsiveness are recorded skipped until then), run on the build copy (mold + packs, mold_v0-024) and pass, including a two-workspace context lane over every workspace-scoped table, snapshot, credential and run result
a fixture run kind goes through claim, events, complete, retry and cancel, with its cost from gateway usage and its egress allowlist enforced
deployed: an app from the shell live on Vercel (two projects) with its own database and its brand: a client signs in, calls a pack tool, starts a run, and the run's result and metered cost show in the console
secrets present by name only in state; workspace credentials reach a run by name only (canary test: zero hits)
released: the second app (an audit-agent pack) minted from the same shell with no shell change: deployed, lanes passing, a first run end to end
onboarding works end to end for a new workspace from pack-declared steps
docs, pricing/packaging and the operator runbook written
